name: @epoch/capability-discovery
description: Epoch Capability Discovery kernel (W045, ACR-004) — the universal Role & Capability Discovery Plane: a provider-neutral task-signal -> capability-demand compiler, universal role-proposal synthesis (no predefined role/model pairs; domain-pack templates are priors, never a second compiler authority), candidate resolution over agent registrations / human declarations / capability-registry records / external candidate profiles, capability-gap lifecycle (UNSATISFIED -> CANDIDATE_FOUND -> EVALUATED -> VERIFIED/DEGRADED/REQUIRES_HUMAN), candidate-organization composition and declared-criteria evaluation, content-addressed reproducible discovery-run lineage (digest chains inputs -> demands -> roles -> resolution -> organizations -> evaluation -> selection, with a tamper-detecting verify function), the deployment-neutral ecosystem-discovery scheduler contract with an in-memory reference driver, a provider-neutral source-adapter interface with a static-catalog fixture adapter, the safe ingestion/sandbox/profile/evaluation/promotion boundary for external candidates (discovery never grants execution authority, never mutates authoritative state), and the ecosystem proposal mechanism for adapters/extensions/new domain packs. Deterministic: zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied. NO persistence, NO network, NO provider vocabulary.
